company.name: Roblox
company.shortDescription: Roblox operates an online platform for user-generated games and immersive 3D experiences.
company.description: Roblox is a platform for online gaming and entertainment that provides a communal digital experience that unites individuals via play. It enables anyone to imagine, create, and have fun with friends as they explore interactive 3D experiences produced by developers using their desktop design tool, Roblox Studio.

productsAndServices.description: An online platform for creating, discovering, and participating in user-generated games and immersive 3D experiences across supported devices.

productsAndServices.description: A development environment for building, scripting, testing, and publishing Roblox games and other interactive 3D experiences.
productsAndServices.name: Roblox Studio

productsAndServices.description: A web-based suite of tools for managing Roblox experiences, teams, analytics, publishing, monetization, moderation, and creator revenue.

productsAndServices.description: Digital marketplaces for discovering, purchasing, creating, and selling avatar items, virtual assets, models, plugins, and other creator content.

productsAndServices.description: A digital commerce system centered on Robux that supports virtual item purchases, in-experience transactions, subscriptions, paid access, and creator payouts.

productsAndServices.description: Advertising and branded-experience services that let advertisers reach Roblox audiences through immersive ads, sponsored experiences, search placements, video ads, and homepage campaigns.

aiResearchSummary.text: Roblox is researching simulation and presentation of shared 3D experiences, such as in Primal solver for simulation and display of rigid bodies in a virtual and Simulation of rigid bodies, plus scalable fluid and aerodynamic models for real-time distributed physics. Work like Automatic personalized avatar generation from 2d images, Dynamic head generation for animation, Hair design and rendering, Layered clothing that conforms to an underlying body and/or clothing layer, and Optimized player positioning system in virtual experiences advances avatar realism, user safety, accessibility, content moderation, adaptive voice and translation, recommendations, and interactive digital advertising within virtual experiences. Together these efforts span physics engines, avatar systems, safety and moderation, personalization, networking, and monetization in virtual environments.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,399,999,985 to $29,500,000,000, a 12.29x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 88 (-7 over 90 days) and market heat at 75 (-16).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Minecraft, Manticore Games, Rec Room.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
